meta.description: The Academia story: an Arabic-first team building an organization and achievement platform for high-school students.

about.h1: We built Academia because we lived the chaos
about.sub: Files lost in group chats, questions with no answers, and a national exam getting closer. So we built the tidy place we wished we had.
about.mission: Help every Arabic-speaking student turn a pile of files into a clear plan they can actually finish, step by step.

values.d: A strict tree: term → subject → unit → lesson. Nothing gets lost, nothing lands in the wrong place.
Parents see consistency and progress summaries only — not your chats or your daily details.
An RTL interface designed in Arabic from scratch, with full English as a second option.
A progress counter, a day streak, and a mistake bank — progress you can see, not just feel.

about.teamSub: A small team of engineers, teachers and designers working close to students and schools.

team.d: Research with real students before any screen ships.
A fast platform that works on weak networks and mid-range devices.
Teachers review the taxonomy and question bank before publishing.

items.q: How do I create an account?
items.a: On the sign-up page pick your role (student or parent) then fill in your name, email and password. Teachers register from the teacher page because their account needs verification.

items.q: I forgot my password, what now?
items.a: Open the reset page, enter your email, and you'll get a link to set a new password.

items.q: Do I stay signed in after closing the browser?
items.a: Yes, your session is saved. For your security you're signed out automatically after two hours of inactivity.

items.q: What's the difference between Free and Premium?
items.a: Free includes the library, communities, schedule and the progress counter. Premium adds the exam simulator, mistake bank, the 15-minute review, and the parent report.
Yes, any time. Your subscription stays active until the end of the paid period.
In a strict tree: term → subject → unit → lesson, with advanced search and favorites.

items.q: I found violating content, what do I do?
items.a: Use the report button on the lesson; our moderation team reviews it and violating content may be removed.
A weekly summary of consistency and progress only — not your community chats or daily activity details.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: From the settings page, or by contacting support; your account and related data are removed.
